Power exponent Goto,LEFT/RIGHT,and nested radical/fraction arguments are measured through native key sequences. Source positions account for the generated ^( prefix and recurse through editable slots.

The ten-value nth-root radicand control succeeds,result3.802952461. The11-value radicand raises Stack ERROR on PLUS;the11-value index with radicand8 produces a result. These native expectations demonstrate stack-order differences from the current radicand-first serialization.
Nth-root input/error/Goto continuation and both11-value order probes are deferred. No nth-root source-map workaround or changed mathematical serialization is introduced in this milestone.

template-goto-nth-input.reason: Nth-root evaluation/stack order remains deferred.
